dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are your plans after the booty's distributed?

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: How do I put this? I've always had my eye on the process of making money. Never gave much thought to what to do afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: Maybe I'll go get a hundred servings of Zhongyuan Chop Suey and treat everyone... Who knows?

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: Some people think results are everything. But if you think about it, if living itself is all about results, what does living even mean?

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: I'd say that if you just look at results, you'll miss out on a lot.
